title: An Altar of Ones and Zeros

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: Ones and zeros and an atrium to study them in.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ones and zeros and an atrium to study them in.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: The Church of the Binary God has allowed for the inter-personal-space study project to commence! IPSSP whooo!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Church of the Binary God has allowed for the inter-personal-space study project to commence! IPSSP whooo!

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: It would be, but there's a problem. At least for me anyway.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It would be, but there's a problem. At least for me anyway.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: It's a coding framework that allows for the user to participate in truth seeking through a self-guided data run they can do at home.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a coding framework that allows for the user to participate in truth seeking through a self-guided data run they can do at home.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: Hence the truth seeking aspect of the ordeal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hence the truth seeking aspect of the ordeal.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: Don't have a place to do it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't have a place to do it.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: Why do you say that?

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: The Scripture of Ones and Zeros is NOT hokum. It's a beautiful translation of our world. My flat just isn't the right place. It's too... plain.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Scripture of Ones and Zeros is NOT hokum. It's a beautiful translation of our world. My flat just isn't the right place. It's too... plain.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: I have a flat, thank you. Just not one that's of the caliber this needs. It's too... plain.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have a flat, thank you. Just not one that's of the caliber this needs. It's too... plain.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: Thank you!!! Ones be praised!

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: Pleeeasssseee! This is my way to self-discovery! I just need help, you know, discovering it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pleeeasssseee! This is my way to self-discovery! I just need help, you know, discovering it.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: Yeah? You'd turn my place into an altar for the Binary God?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah? You'd turn my place into an altar for the Binary God?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...I'm sorry?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's up, Magz?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's the IPSSP about?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds interesting.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's a lot of big words.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's a lot of big words.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's a lot of big words.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's a lot of big words.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ah. Well, that's great!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You don't have a home?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Probably for the best.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Lotta hokum to be bringing into your house.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lotta hokum to be bringing into your house.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Lotta hokum to be bringing into your house.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Lotta hokum to be bringing into your house.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: On second thought...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can help you spruce it up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can help you spruce it up.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I can help you spruce it up.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I can help you spruce it up.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine.
